author.name: Marie Antoinette
author.heading: About Marie Antoinette
author.bio: Marie Antoinette (1755–1793), born an Austrian archduchess, married the future Louis XVI and became queen of France. Her life at Versailles ended amid the Revolution; she was imprisoned, tried by the Revolutionary Tribunal and executed on 16 October 1793.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The saying is placed at Marie Antoinette’s execution in October 1793. Its cited English account appeared more than sixty years later, making the distinction between an execution-era statement and a later retelling essential. The historical setting is well documented even though the exact exchange is less securely established.
